description: Aerial drone photograph (DJI filename) of a dry, scrub-covered coastal hillside beside turquoise water, with two red annotation arrows added. Arrow #1 points to a dark-green door-like structure set into the hillside below a gravel road, resembling a bunker or utility entrance; arrow #2 points toward a shoreline area near a white open-sided pavilion, a small green shed, and a concrete ramp/dock. The scene is consistent with widely circulated drone imagery of Little St. James Island (Jeffrey Epstein's island), where such doors were claimed by researchers to be tunnel or bunker entrances, but the location is not confirmed by anything in the image itself.
flags: Location consistent with but not confirmed as Little St. James Island; drone imagery of this kind circulated with claims of hidden tunnel/bunker entrances that remain unverified

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2173 as rendered on a Q aggregator site, posted Sep 15 2018 under tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI with an attached image filename link. The drop is a rhetorical unity message claiming 'they' want people divided by race, religion, culture, class, and political affiliation, ending with the WWG1WGA slogan.

description: Candid 1990s color photograph of Donald Trump seated in an audience, clasping hands with Rev. Jesse Jackson, who reaches over with a hand on Trump's shoulder, while a long-haired man widely identified as Rev. Al Sharpton leans in between them. Other attendees, largely African American men in suits, sit in rows behind them. The filename dates the scene to 1997 at the WTC Marriott, consistent with Jesse Jackson's Rainbow/PUSH Wall Street Project events Trump attended in the late 1990s.
flags: Sharpton identification from distinctive appearance and common captioning of this widely circulated photo; date/venue (1997, WTC Marriott) taken from filename, not visible in image

description: Red-carpet style photograph at a Hip-Hop Summit event sponsored by PlayStation 2, showing four people posed before a step-and-repeat backdrop: Rev Run (Joseph Simmons) of Run-DMC in a black hat and clerical collar, Donald Trump in a suit and striped tie, Melania (then Melania Knauss) in a black dress, and Hip-Hop Summit co-founder Russell Simmons in a blue cap and track jacket. The filename ('00TRUMPRACEweb2-articleLarge.jpg') indicates it illustrated a New York Times article on Trump and race.
text: HIP-HOP SUMMIT. PlayStation.2. HIP-HOP SUMMIT. PlayStation.2. HIP-HOP SUMMIT
flags: Event date/location not shown in image; early-2000s Hip-Hop Summit inferred from backdrop

description: Red-carpet photograph of rapper Snoop Dogg, in white sunglasses, a yellow shirt, white jacket and gold chain, shaking hands with Donald Trump, in a dark suit and red tie, in front of a step-and-repeat backdrop for the Comedy Central Roast of Donald Trump (March 2011, New York). Backdrop shows 'Roast of Trump' logos, the #TRUMPROAST hashtag, the Comedy Central logo, and a partially visible Taco Bell sponsor logo. Filename indicates an AP wire photo used by ABC News.
text: ROAST. AST of UMP. #TRUMPROAST. COMEDY CENTRAL. ACO ELL. TRUMP
flags: Event (2011 Comedy Central Roast of Donald Trump) identified from backdrop text and widely published versions of this photo; date/location not shown in image
